## Overview
### Technical Overview of Kwaipilot: KAT-Coder-Pro V2
Kwaipilot: KAT-Coder-Pro V2 is a cutting-edge language model developed by Kwaipilot, released on 2024-01-01. This standard-tier model is not open source, offering a unique set of capabilities including text, function calling, JSON mode, streaming, and structured outputs. The architecture of KAT-Coder-Pro V2 is designed to handle a context window of up to 256,000 tokens and can generate a maximum output of 80,000 tokens. With a knowledge cutoff of 2023-12, this model is well-suited for a variety of applications, including chat, text generation, coding, analysis, and summarization.

### Strengths and Use Cases
The primary strengths of Kwaipilot: KAT-Coder-Pro V2 lie in its ability to handle complex tasks such as function calling and structured outputs, making it an ideal choice for coding and analysis applications. Its support for streaming and JSON mode also enables efficient processing of large datasets. The model's capabilities are further enhanced by its high performance on benchmarks such as MMLU (80.0) and LMSYS Arena ELO (1200). With its versatility and robust performance, KAT-Coder-Pro V2 is best suited for applications such as chat, text generation, coding, analysis, RAG pipelines, and summarization.

        # Generate response using KAT-Coder-Pro V2

        return response
